editorial.thesis: A hospitality-and-food-and-drink city of about 26,000. Its retail is heavy on cafés, tea & coffee and restaurants & fast food, and thin on coaching & training and banks & atms — and 100% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 0% of Bengaluru's. 0.0 chain outlets per lakh residents against 63.31 in Bengaluru; 0 of the 51 national brands we track are present.

The mapped economy leans to hotels & stays. Shares of all mapped places: hotels & stays 38.0% (Bengaluru 4.0%); food & beverage 20.8% (Bengaluru 9.8%); shops & retail 9.7% (Bengaluru 16.0%). Raw counts would mislead because Bengaluru is mapped more completely (108,499 places against 679), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 2 zones hold 100% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Gokarn alone has about 16,000 residents and 34 mapped food & drink places.
Retail is more concentrated than in Bengaluru. 46% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Bengaluru 40%). The largest cores are Gokarn (127 places) and Bankikodla (17).

The widest brand gaps against Bengaluru. Apollo Pharmacy 0 outlets vs 283; MedPlus 0 outlets vs 273; Café Coffee Day 0 outlets vs 221. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 5 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Bengaluru, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Gokarn and Bankikodla are the largest zones by residents (16,000 and 6,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 46% of all commercial places, and Gokarn alone lists 127.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Gokarn holds 0 of the 0 tracked chain outlets, and Bankikodla adds 0.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Gokarn and Bankikodla lead on education places (4 and 1, with 1 and 0 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Gokarn and Bankikodla. The blue cores include Gokarn.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (108,499 places in Bengaluru against 679 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Bengaluru; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Bengaluru, Gokarna's mapped places over-index on hotels & stays (38.0% vs 4.0%), food & beverage (20.8% vs 9.8%) and under-index on shops & retail (9.7% vs 16.0%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 0 outlets of 0 tracked national brands within 5 km — 0.0 per lakh residents against Bengaluru's 63.31 (2535 outlets of 51 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Bengaluru are Apollo Pharmacy (0 vs 283); MedPlus (0 vs 273); Café Coffee Day (0 vs 221). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Bengaluru's, so low means thin by Bengaluru's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 5 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Gokarna's age mix against Bengaluru: children (0–14) 21.3% vs 22.8%, 15–24 18.4% vs 19.5%, working age 50.2% vs 50.2%, 60+ 10.1% vs 7.5%. Under-25s are 40% of residents.

zones.581319: An under-served zone: about 6,000 residents, 17 mapped places, 0 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 13.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 15.9% of mapped places against 7.0% in Bengaluru — above its share.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 10.9% of mapped places against 2.6% in Bengaluru — above its share.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.4% of mapped places against 0.8% in Bengaluru — below its share.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 3.8% of mapped places against 2.5% in Bengaluru — above its share.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.6% of mapped places against 1.4% in Bengaluru — below its share.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 4.7% of mapped places against 5.1% in Bengaluru, so the mix is level.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 1.2% of mapped places against 6.6% in Bengaluru — below its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 0.3% of mapped places against 2.4% in Bengaluru — below its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 1.9% of mapped places against 3.8% in Bengaluru — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
